name: Dens
overview: The Bible depicts dens as places of refuge and protection during times of distress. In Judges 6:2, the Israelites took shelter in dens, caves, and strongholds to escape the oppression of the Midianites. Hebrews 11:38 highlights that faithful believers sometimes found themselves wandering and seeking safety in dens and caves of the earth, symbolizing trials endured by God's people. Revelation 6:15 describes even the powerful hiding in dens and mountain rocks in fear of God's judgment, emphasizing that no earthly status can provide ultimate security apart from Him.
